quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Energy Solution sustainability report: 2025 Sustainability Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company profile: AES's main product is lithium battery modules, made in Changshu (China), Vietnam and Hsinchu (Taiwan). In data-center backup batteries, continued data-center market growth will lift data-center backup battery demand; as cloud service providers build hyperscale data centers, demand for battery modules for medium-to-large industrial energy-storage systems rises, and the company works closely with international tier-one brand customers, which it calls an important growth engine for the coming years. Its BBU (Backup Battery Unit) module was the first BBU worldwide to pass third-party EPD verification (company claim), renewed in 2025.
